Big_Gator_STD1000DGNP.title: Standard V-DrillGuide 1/8 to 3/8, STD1000DGNP
Big_Gator_STD1000DGNP.disposition: Exclude this model from the 13/32-inch final wood-bore option. Do not transfer another Big Gator model's range or dimensions to it.

Big_Gator_method_FAQ.title: Drill Guide FAQs
Big_Gator_method_FAQ.limits: This method supports considering a clamp-on factory guide. It supplies no quantitative accuracy for this project. The rectangular 3/8-to-1/2 variant needs its own product identity, hole list and dimensions before a geometry comparison; the FAQ is not those specifications.

paired_stack_reach_envelope.role: A conditional sizing relation for a guide placed directly on the matched wood pair; not the existing generic or catalog-adapter geometry and not a manufactured fixture.
paired_stack_reach_envelope.projection_relation: Required usable projection = actual guide-top-to-wood offset + 85.05 mm, under the retained 0.5-mm stack allowance and 6.35-mm breakout condition.
paired_stack_reach_envelope.limits: The 36.95-mm value only subtracts the 83.05-mm pair/breakout reference from the catalog NL. It is not a permitted guide height, usable flute guarantee or a mandatory full-top chip route. Actual point, flute, guide entrance/exit, lower outlet and chuck engagement remain unknown. No actual guide height is substituted.

diameter_scope.meaning: Both are catalog presentations of the 13/32-inch nominal size. Decimal rounding and unpublished tool/guide tolerances prevent either a fit guarantee or an incompatibility conclusion from this 0.00125-mm difference. The manufacturer's 13/32 hole listing does not establish the original 0.10-mm maximum play condition.
